description: This Python source file implements a service class 'FixerService' responsible for automatically fixing assets by replacing old logos with new ones. It includes methods for loading detections, selecting new logos, fixing individual assets, and fixing all assets in a job. The class interacts with various models and services related to assets, issues, and job status management.

classes.description: A service class that applies automatic fixes to assets by replacing detected old logos with new logos.
